title: UX DESIGN IN THE ERA OF AI
subtitle: A Working Guide for Designers
description: From Research to Prototyping, Testing to Career Development. For Junior and Mid-Career UX Professionals Learning to Work Alongside AI Without Losing the Plot.
intro: AI moved from a suggestion in a sidebar to the thing that builds your prototype. This is a rewrite for that reality, current as of 2026.
It's written for junior and mid-career designers who want to direct these tools well without becoming either a hype merchant or a doomer.
The premise held up: AI won't replace UX designers, but it is quietly sorting the ones who can direct it from the ones who can't.
Seven parts cover the new landscape, research and its traps, ideation and writing, prototyping and design-to-code, testing, designing AI-powered products, and your career.
You'll find real incidents, specific tools, and exercises to do with the tools open. The tool names will age; the judgment underneath shouldn't.
